subject: Multi-zone purge scope and residency map — clarification & MAP request
messages:
From: Jared Collins <jared.collins@medicacloud.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: olivia.legal@medicacloud.com
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Configurable retention by geography — initial ask

Hi Soojin / Karthik,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. MedicaCloud is mapping out an initiative to ensure all EU patient-derived model inputs and inference logs are kept within EU zoned storage and subject to a 7-year retention window, with the ability for us to trigger selective purges for specific tenants or datasets on demand. A few concrete questions to help us scope the project: 

- Can Redwood expose a per-tenant retention policy that is both region-scoped (e.g., EU-only) and schedule-driven (soft-delete -> hard-delete timeline)?
- When a tenant requests a selective purge, can the system guarantee eventual hard-delete of all replicas (object store + any cache layers + shard backups) and provide a verifiable audit trail?
- What admin APIs / webhooks will we use to trigger purges and receive completion events?

Attached a simple diagram of how our data flows across zones. Also cc'd our legal lead (Olivia) — she'll have follow-ups on legal hold/temporary suspension.

Attachments: [MedicaCloud_GDPR_block_diagram.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks,
Jared Collins
Head of Platform, MedicaCloud
jared.collins@medicacloud.com


From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Collins <jared.collins@medicacloud.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Configurable retention by geography — initial ask

Jared — thanks for the notes and the diagram.

Quick answers up front: yes, we can support per-tenant retention profiles with region binding and a two-stage (soft-delete -> hard-delete) lifecycle. The tricky bits are cross-zone replication lag, auditability for rapid purges, and legal-hold semantics — those will influence the rollout timeline.

Can you confirm the following before we scope an internal MAP?
- Will MedicaCloud require hard-delete confirmation across all replicas within a strict SLA (e.g., 24h) or is a best-effort window acceptable?
- Are legal holds expected to supersede tenant-triggered purges (i.e., if legal hold active, deletion must be deferred)?
- Do you expect retention to apply to derived artifacts (embeddings/indices) or only raw inputs + logs?

Proposed next step: a 60-min workshop next week with infra + product to draft a mutual action plan (MAP). I've looped in Marissa (product) and Karthik (infra) to prepare a proposed architecture sketch.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Product 
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, Jared Collins <jared.collins@medicacloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Configurable retention by geography — initial ask

On Fri, Oct 01, 2026 at 11:03 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Jared — thanks for the notes and the diagram.

Jared — coupling a per-tenant retention policy with zone-binding is straightforward from a config layer perspective; the operational constraints are in the storage tier and cache invalidation paths. A few implementation notes from infra: 

- Storage model: we'll bind tenant objects to a region tag at write time and ensure replicas stay in the same geofence class. That requires per-tenant placement metadata and a GC worker aware of zone-level state.
- Purge semantics: we can support a two-stage lifecycle (soft-delete tombstone -> background hard-delete). Hard-delete will iterate across object store, KV caches, and async backups. For guaranteed cross-replica hard-delete within 24h we need a dedicated purge pipeline and prioritized GC workers; that's a non-trivial infra cost.
- Auditability: we'll emit a purge_event with per-object traces and a final purge_manifest (signed) when the job completes. That manifest can be surfaced via admin API and stored for compliance.

I've attached a short YAML sketch of a zone policy and a pointer to our internal design for zone-policy-v2.

Attachments: [zone-policy-draft.yml (text)]

Proposed timeline (initial MVP):
- Week 1–2: privacy & legal review + design workshop (MAP kickoff)
- Week 3–6: infra work (per-tenant placement, GC worker)
- Week 7–9: admin APIs + webhooks + audit manifest
- Week 10: staging validation with MedicaCloud sample workload

If MedicaCloud needs strict 24h hard-delete SLAs we should factor that into cost / reserved capacity (priority purge lanes).

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Staff Engineer, Infra
Redwood Inference

From: Lena Müller <lena.mueller@medicacloud.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.legal@medicacloud.com>, Jared Collins <jared.collins@medicacloud.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2026 10:22:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Configurable retention by geography — initial ask

Thanks for the detail Karthik — that matches our expectations. A few clarifications from the MedicaCloud side: 

- We do need an auditable manifest proving deletion of replicas for regulatory audit. Signed manifest is ideal.
- Legal holds will be issued by our compliance team and must block any purge (they are rare but non-negotiable). Please add an API flag to check for active holds before processing a purge.
- Derived artifacts: yes — embeddings/indices created from EU patient data must follow the same retention rules.
- For the initial rollout, we can accept a 72h hard-delete window if you can provide prioritized purge lanes as an add-on option.

We are happy to do a joint staging run in week 10 as proposed. Also, Olivia may follow up with a short questionnaire for SOC2 evidence around purge audit trails.

Regards,
Lena Müller
Product Manager — Data Privacy, MedicaCloud

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Jared Collins <jared.collins@medicacloud.com>, lena.mueller@medicacloud.com, olivia.legal@medicacloud.com
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Configurable retention by geography — initial ask

Folks — consolidating next steps and action items (MAP draft attached). High level: MedicaCloud requires EU-zone retention, derived-artifact coverage, legal-hold checks that prevent purges, an auditable signed purge_manifest, and a prioritized purge lane option (72h SLA acceptable for MVP).

Action items (owners + target dates):
- Product (Marissa) — finalize retention policy UX & tenant config schema; update admin console to show zone binding + legal-hold status. Due: 2026-10-15
- Infra (Karthik) — implement per-tenant placement metadata, GC worker, and purge manifest generator. Provide admin API + webhook for purge completion. Spike done: 2026-10-12; MVP: 2026-11-12
- Compliance (Redwood) — prepare SOC2 evidence folder and sample purge_manifest format for MedicaCloud review. Owner: Soojin. Due: 2026-10-20
- MedicaCloud — provide a representative dataset and legal-hold workflow examples for staging validation. Due: 2026-10-22

I'll schedule the kickoff workshop for next Tue 10/12 and share a calendar invite with a short agenda (design goals, scope, MAP fields, test acceptance).

Attachments: [MAP_MedicaCloud_20261007.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Director, Product
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
